strategies.name: liquidity_grab_reversal
strategies.entry_summary: Look for a liquidity grab where price briefly breaks support or resistance and then reverses. Enter at the price level of the candle that made the liquidity grab: for longs after a downside sweep of support, and for shorts after an upside sweep of resistance.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop loss just beyond the liquidity-grab candle/extreme. Take profit at a recent swing high for longs or a recent swing low for shorts, aiming to capture the reversal with a large risk-reward.

variants.timeframe_note: Works on all time frames; examples include 15-minute and daily-context discussion

result.enumeration_note: The video teaches one reversal skeleton throughout: liquidity-grab reversal entry with stop beyond the grab and target at recent swing high/low; indicator use, divergence, higher-timeframe S/R, and 10-candle proximity are compatible confluence/optimization variants rather than distinct strategies.
